explanation: Despite countless TV dramas, judges in England and Wales do not use gavels, and nor do Scotland's. In the US they are common, in courts and in Congress.

claims.text: Judges in the courts of England and Wales do not use gavels.
Scottish courts do not use gavels either.
Gavels are common in US courtrooms and are used by the presiding officers of the US Congress.
